description: This dataset contains detailed information on 52,478 books listed in the GoodReads Best Books Ever collection — the platform’s largest public book list. Collected as part of the UOC Master’s in Data Science (Tipology and Data Life Cycle) course, the dataset includes 25 variables describing each book’s metadata, such as identifiers, titles, authors, genres, publication details, formats, and popularity metrics. Key features include ratings, number of ratings, genres, awards, and publication dates, with additional derived metrics like likedPercent and bbeScore (ranking within the Best Books Ever list). Some fields, such as series, edition, awards, and characters, are only partially complete, reflecting variability in GoodReads data. The dataset also provides cover image URLs and price information sourced from Iberlibro. Dates are formatted inconsistently between two retrieval batches (first 30,000 vs. remaining 22,478 records). Overall, this dataset offers a rich resource for analyzing literary trends, reader preferences, author popularity, and book metadata patterns, and is suitable for tasks such as recommendation modeling, text analysis, and data cleaning exercises.
